description: Overlays multiple `v-sparkline` components on a shared scale with axes, gridlines and a combined tooltip.

props.height: Height of the plot area. Children fill it unless they set their own `height`, which renders them as a band anchored to the bottom.
props.interactive: Enables a shared crosshair, markers on every series, and keyboard navigation (arrow keys). Replaces the per-sparkline interaction.
props.max: Upper bound of the shared scale. When omitted, it is derived from the data and rounded to a tick.
props.min: Lower bound of the shared scale. When omitted, it is derived from the data and rounded to a tick.
props.tooltip: Displays one tooltip listing the value of every series at the active point. Requires **interactive**. Can be `true` or an object with `location` (`'left'` or `'right'` of the crosshair, flipped when there is no room inside the plot), `offset` and `class`.
props.xAxis: Shows the horizontal axis. Can be `true` or an object with `labels` (spread evenly from the first to the last point), or `ticks` (count) and `format` (receives the point index, also used as the tooltip title).
props.yAxis: Shows the vertical axis. Can be `true` or an object with `ticks` (approximate count), `format` (receives the value) and `grid` to draw a line at every tick.

slots.default: The `v-sparkline` components to plot. A sparkline with its own `min` or `max` keeps an independent scale and is excluded from the y-axis.
slots.tooltip: Custom content for the combined tooltip. Receives `{ index: number, items: { index, value, color, type }[] }`, one item per sparkline.
